authorized_change.reason: Supply the minimum annotated GenBank structure required by SNPPar without changing sequence data, benchmark mutations, phylogeny, truth or scored endpoints.
requirements: Require the scenario variable positions as an input.
Preserve the root nucleotide sequence exactly.
Select deterministically the first consecutive three-base interval containing no variable position.
Emit exactly one synthetic CDS feature at that interval.
Assign that CDS a stable synthetic locus_tag.
Do not place any benchmark variable position inside the synthetic CDS.
Update toy validation for the amended function contract.
Add focused assertions for CDS presence, deterministic placement and non-overlap with variable positions.

triggering_observations.observed_failure: SNPPar successfully read the toy SNP alignment and reference sequence but failed while constructing its gene index because the synthetic GenBank fixture contained no CDS feature.
triggering_observations.source_behavior: SNPPar indexes CDS features. Its zero-CDS fallback references an out-of-scope variable and fails before tree processing.
